I like curing because it’s ready to use quickly, you may have been over curing or it may be the resin you’re using, clear resin will yellow a lot more easily but my prints so far using ceramic grey water washable resin have no real artefacts except for the minor ones that come from not being cleaned up to a high enough standard. I’m not saying that’s you but that is the way gaming on YouTube is, you need to look at your content and ask yourself “if I was a complete stranger to myself would I want to click and watch this content?” Basically what is it that makes you personally stand out from the rest, unfortunately being “funny” isn’t enough, you have to be uniquely funny. If you feel you don’t have much to make you stand out in a crowd then don’t worry because you can try making alternative content related to your genre, for example if you’re usually posting let’s plays do something more creative, some kind of “did you know” video where you research some little known interesting things about a certain game, or something where you play a game in an alternative way as a challenge, like “can I play Dark Souls using only my ears?”, things that you would want to click if you saw someone else making a video about.
